title: The Quest for a Stolen Scepter
pack_name: The Quest for a Stolen Scepter

signs.title: Maps are sold in no shop.

dialog.header: The Royal Hall of King Aldric
dialog.body:
King Aldric greets you,
brave one.

Bring back the stolen Scepter
and the four continents will
be at peace again.

audience.intro:
Horns sound as you enter
the great hall.

King Aldric steps down
from his throne and
declares:            (space)
audience.rank_up:
Well done, %NAME%.

From this day you serve
as %RANK%.
audience.more_needed:
Patience, %NAME%.

Bring %NEEDED% more villains
to justice and I will
raise you higher.
audience.final_rank:
%NAME% the %RANK%,

Find my Scepter before
the days run out, or the
realm is lost!

artifacts.name: The Bulwark of Ages
artifacts.effect: Your army takes a quarter less damage.

artifacts.name: The Ring of Many Words
artifacts.effect: You can hold twice as many spells.

groups.label: Art made for this game by:

copyright: The Quest for a Stolen Scepter

win.body:
Victory!
The Scepter is home
and the villains are
in chains. Peace
returns to the four
continents.

Songs will be sung
of %NAME%, the
%RANK% who
brought it back.

The castles are
yours to keep, and
the King triples
your pay.

Final Score:
%SCORE%

lose.body:
%NAME% the
%RANK%,
the days are spent
and the Scepter is
still lost.
Without it the King
cannot hold the
realm together.
Villains roam free,
the towns bar their
gates, and your
soldiers drift
home one by one.
Time was the enemy
you could not beat.

Final Score:
%SCORE%

banners.chest_gold:
Beneath an old stone you
find a buried hoard.
You may:
A) Keep the %GOLD% gold.
B) Share it with the local
folk, which raises your
leadership by %LEADERSHIP%.
banners.chest_commission:
Your scouts report rich
veins of ore in the hills.

The Crown is pleased and
raises your weekly pay
by %POINTS%
banners.chest_spell_power:
Among the stones you find
an old sealed flask. You
open it, and the spirit
bound inside raises your
Spell Power by %POINTS%
before it fades away.
banners.chest_max_spells:
Wandering herders share
their fire with your army.
Their elder shows you an
old way of holding spells.
Your maximum spell capacity
is increased by %POINTS%
banners.chest_new_spell:
You catch a small goblin
stealing from your camp.
To buy its freedom, it
teaches you:

   %COUNT% %SPELL% spell.
banners.town_contract_new:
Wanted: %VILLAIN%.
Bounty: %REWARD% gold.
Last sighted in %ZONE%.
banners.town_contract_none: There are no contracts to take.
banners.town_intel_monsters_generic:
Monsters of many kinds
  hold the walls.
banners.spell_bridge_prompt:
Raise a bridge which way?
Use the arrow keys.
banners.spell_bridge_built:
A bridge of %COUNT% spans
rises from the water.
banners.spell_castle_gate_none:
You know no castles to
open a gate to yet.
banners.spell_town_gate_none:
You know no towns to
open a gate to yet.
banners.spell_instant_army_no_room: There is no room in your army!
banners.encounter_join_named:
%LABEL% %TROOP%
admire your banner and
ask to march with you.
banners.encounter_join_numeric:
%COUNT% %TROOP%
admire your banner and
ask to march with you.
banners.encounter_wanderers:
They scatter the moment
they see your army.
banners.alcove_offer:
An old wizard offers to
teach you spellcraft for
%COST% gold.

Accept?
banners.alcove_already:
The wizard smiles.
You know magic already.
banners.alcove_taught:
The wizard shares his
lore. Magic is now yours
to command.
banners.alcove_no_gold:
Come back with %COST%
gold. Lessons are not
free.
banners.no_spell_banner:
You know no spells yet.
Seek the magic alcove in
%ZONE% at %X%,%Y% to
learn spellcasting.
banners.new_game_intro:
%NAME% the %CLASS%,
Your realm is being
prepared. One moment
while the world takes
shape.
banners.dwelling_recruit_prompt:
%COUNT% %TROOP% are here.
Cost %COST% each. Gold %GOLD%
You can hire up to %CAP%.
banners.dwelling_none_this_week:
Nobody will join you
this week.
banners.telecave_teleport:
The cave runs deep and
lets you out elsewhere
on this continent.
banners.telecave_inert:
The cave is quiet. Its
magic has gone to sleep.
banners.crystal_ball_pickup:
The crystal ball shows
you the whole of %ZONE%!
banners.astrology_body:
The stargazers say:
The week of %TROOP%

Every %TROOP% dwelling
fills up again.      (space)
banners.temp_death:
Beaten in battle, you are
carried back to the Royal
Hall. King Aldric sighs,
lectures you on tactics,
then grants you a fresh
commission and sends
you out once more.
banners.combat_give_up_body:
Surrender costs you every
army and sends you home
to the King. Surrender
banners.body_save_confirm:
Your game is saved.
Ctrl-Q quits; any other
key returns to the game.
banners.body_dismiss_last:
Dismissing your last army
sends you home to the
crown in disgrace.
Dismiss it?
banners.body_home_castle:
The Royal Hall

A) Recruit soldiers
B) Speak with the King
banners.body_own_castle:
%NAME%:
1. Leave troops here
2. Take troops back
banners.body_no_continents:
You know no other
continents from here.
banners.body_must_be_sailing:
Only a ship can carry
you to another continent.
banners.cannot_garrison_last:
Your last army must
      stay with you!
banners.no_troop_slots: Your army has no free slot!
banners.army_cannot_handle:
You cannot lead that
many troops.
banners.no_troops_to_garrison: You have no troops to leave.
banners.spell_not_known: You do not know that spell.

ottoline.features:
Ink-stained fingers, a
ledger chained to her belt.
ottoline.crimes:
Taxed whole villages into
ruin and kept every coin.

jessa.features:
A knife on each hip and a
smile with one gold tooth.
jessa.crimes:
Robbed every caravan on
the south road for a year.

morwen.features:
Carries a lantern that
never lights the ground.
morwen.crimes:
Led travellers into the
marsh with false lights.

harrek.features:
Wolfskin cloak, a whistle
of yellowed bone.
harrek.crimes:
Set his hounds on farmers
who would not pay him.

edric.features:
Polished armour, a crest
he has scratched off.
edric.crimes:
Sold the border forts to
raiders for a bag of gold.

isolde.features:
White as chalk, and her
feet leave no tracks.
isolde.crimes:
Holds a manor full of
spirits and stolen knights.

torvald.features:
Grey beard, a voice like
a drill sergeant's drum.
torvald.crimes:
Deserted the royal army
and took a regiment along.

elowen.features:
Moss in her hair, eyes
the colour of new leaves.
elowen.crimes:
Turned the old groves
against every woodcutter.

grubnak.features:
Enormous, with a belt made
of stolen church bells.
grubnak.crimes:
Raided the river towns
and ate the town council.

mordecai.features:
Smells of turned earth;
wears a gravedigger's hat.
mordecai.crimes:
Emptied three cemeteries
to raise a marching host.

nhalia.features:
A nun's robe sewn with
finger bones for buttons.
nhalia.crimes:
Turned a quiet abbey into
a barracks for the dead.

thrumm.features:
Twice the height of a
door, with a dragon's tooth.
thrumm.crimes:
Stole a mountain's worth
of iron and its dragons.

vash.features:
A crown of sharp glass
and a glare to match it.
vash.crimes:
Claimed the islands' gold
and set giants to guard it.

cassian.features:
Black gloves, a signet
ring he never removes.
cassian.crimes:
Plotted to seize the throne
while the King was ill.

valdris.features:
Fine velvet, sharp teeth,
and a very polite voice.
valdris.crimes:
Made bargains for souls
and never paid in full.

oren.features:
Rides a horse whose eyes
burn like coals.
oren.crimes:
Burned the desert wells to
make the tribes kneel.

sorvane.features:
Ash-grey robes, and a
shadow shaped like a wyrm.
sorvane.crimes:
Stole the Scepter and
scattered the realm's peace.
